description: With --ratio 2 the robust detector prints a third alarm (step 8287 down) in a stretch that has been calm since step 6000. Gaussian LR fires 7 times per run.
reproduction: for s in $(seq 0 19); do python -m avmonitor simulate --ratio 1 --seed $s; done
evidence: per-seed robust alarm counts 0 to 3, total 26 (OUR CHECK, SYNTHETIC)
